excerpt: Published in Sequenza 21 NEW YORK Founded in 2012, Decoda is an ensemble, composed of a wind quintet, string quartet, and piano, whose members had worked together in Ensemble Connect, a fellowship program at Carnegie Hall and the Juilliard School. This season the musicians continue that relationship with Carnegie Hall. Their concert last Tuesday at Weill Hall is part of the season’s 250th American anniversary celebrations.
